sections.description:
GOVERNORS (APPOINTMENT AND OATH OF OFFICE) ORDER, 1999
GOVERNORS (APPOINTMENT AND OATH OF OFFICE) ORDER, 1999
ORDER NO. 4 OF 1999
No. 2-24/99-Min.(11), dated 23rd October, 1999.-- In pursuance of
the Proclamation of the Fourteenth day of October, 1999, and the Provisional Constitution
Order No. 1 of 1999 and in exercise of all other powers enabling him in that
behalf, the Chief Executive of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan is pleased to
make and promulgate the following Order for the appointment of Governors:--
1. This Order may be called Governors
(Appointment and Oath of Office) Order (Order No. 4 of 1999).
2. It shall come into force at once and
shall be deemed to have taken effect on the Fourteenth day of October, 1999.
3.
There shall be a Governor for each Province to be appointed by the President,
on the advice of the Chief Executive as provided in Article 3 of the
Provisional Constitution Order No. 1 of 1999.
4.
The Governor shall hold office during the pleasure of the Chief Executive and
shall be entitled to such salary, allowances and privileges as the Chief
Executive may determine.
5. The Governor may, by writing under his
hand addressed to the President resign his office.
6. The Chief Executive may make such
provisions as he thinks fit for the discharge of the functions of a Governor.
7. A
Governor shall not hold any office of profit in the service of Pakistan or
occupy any other position carrying the right to remuneration for the rendering
of services.
8.
When the Governor is absent from Pakistan or is unable to perform the functions
of his office due to any cause, such other person, as the Chief Executive may
direct shall act as Governor.
9. In the performance of his functions, the
Governor shall act in accordance with the advice and directions of the Chief
Executive.
10. Before entering upon office, the Governor
shall make before the Chief Justice of the High Court, oath in the form set out
in the schedule to this Order.
SCHEDULE
(See Article 10)
(In the name of Allah, the most
Beneficent, the most Merciful)
I,................do solemnly swear that I will bear true faith
and allegiance of Pakistan.
That, as Governor of the Province of the.................... I will discharge my duties, and perform my
functions, honestly, to the best of my ability, faithfully in accordance with
the law, and always in the interest of the sovereignty, integrity, solidarity,
well-being and prosperity of Pakistan.
That I will abide by the Proclamation of the Fourteenth day of
October, 1999 and the Provisional Constitution Order No. 1 of 1999 issued by
the Chairman Joint Chiefs of Staff Committee, Chief of Army Staff and the Chief
Executive of the Islamic Republic on the Fourteenth day of October, 1999 and
all subsequent Orders issued by him.
That I will strive to preserve the Islamic Ideology which is the
basis for the creation of Pakistan.
That I will not allow, my personal interest to influence my
official conduct or my official decision.
That, in all circumstances, I will do right to all manner of
people; according to Law, without fear or favour, affection or ill will.
And that I will not directly or indirectly communicate or reveal
to any person any matter which shall be brought under my consideration or shall
become known tome as Governor of the Province of the..........., except as may
be required for the due discharge of my duties as a Governor.;
May Allah Almighty help and guide me (Ameen).
